title: ENVE’s New Melee V2 Proves Hyperbikes Don’t Need to Look Insane
content:
The original Melee had a taste for gravel and room for 35mm tires. The Melee v2 drops the stack, slims the clearance, and hits 6.8kg with an eye on WorldTour racing.

Read the full article at ENVE’s New Melee V2 Proves Hyperbikes Don’t Need to Look Insane on Velo.
author: Josh Ross
